title: What's one investing workflow you wish was automated?
author: i_am_Axzel
selftext:
Everyone has repetitive research tasks.

Mine include checking candles daily.

What's yours?

Some ideas:

\* Reading earnings
\* Tracking promoter holdings
\* Following mutual funds
\* Monitoring sector rotation
\* Comparing valuation history

If software could completely automate one of those, what would you choose?

comments.author: Routine_Bat6675
comments.body: I have a complete workflow with Sentimentick API and IBKR gateway for the execution and it works perfect for me, the only thing that i consider adding is insider sell indicators
